commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
echo "ado_browse(\"code = 'Pub_CDW_BOND_NYCLOSE'\");" | ac_evalform - | ac_trigger_ado.sh -
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/cdw/out ac_extract.sh -c Pub_CDW_BOND_NYCLOSE -t 070000 -i
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/ipv/out ac_blend_extract.sh -t 070000 -i -k 7 Pub_IPV_BOND_NYCLOSE,Pub_IPV_BOND_NYCLOSE_ORIG,Pub_IPV_BOND_NYCLOSE_PREV
else
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/cdw/out ac_extract.sh -d $BusinessDate -c Pub_CDW_BOND_NYCLOSE -t 070000 -i
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/ipv/out ac_blend_extract.sh -d $BusinessDate -t 070000 -i -k 7 Pub_IPV_BOND_NYCLOSE,Pub_IPV_BOND_NYCLOSE_ORIG,Pub_IPV_BOND_NYCLOSE_PREV
fi
jobDescription: This is a command execution job! It executes a script and possible has some parameters passed to it.
